//: Gauntlet run — eight hand-authored chunks laid left to right at chunk row 0, world x 0..2048. Every chunk shares the same floor line (tile y 12-13 dirt over 14-15 stone), so the run is traversable end to end regardless of what is built above it. The single rule below fills everything else: chunk rows >= 1 are solid bedrock (a floor under the floor, so a bolt that punches through the slab makes a pit rather than a void), chunk rows <= -1 are open sky. Enemy placement lives in Stage.cs (Stages 'gauntlet') because it is behaviour, not terrain. The rules seal the run in solid rock rather than in walls: every wall here is destructible (that is the whole game), so a player who spends long enough slamming into the end wall WILL dig through it — measured. Beyond the authored columns they hit bedrock instead of falling into a void with no floor and no respawn.
